messages:
maya: heads up — Flyby just escalated to CS. Customer seeing intermittent 5xx + streaming timeouts. p95 ~10s, tail 504s. Started ~2026-03-17T15:12Z in us-west1 hosted. They say requests hang in the gateway queue then timeout.

jordan: got request ids? any recent deploys to us-west1?

maya: sending a small log slice and repro. request ids: rQ-9932, rQ-9935, rQ-9941. We repro locally by replaying their traffic pattern (many short chats, variable seq len).

maya: ```
2026-03-17T15:12:07.123Z gateway INFO incoming request id=rQ-9932 tenant=flyby size=128
2026-03-17T15:12:07.456Z batcher WARN enqueue delay_ms=186 queue_depth=480 max_depth=512
2026-03-17T15:12:08.910Z runtime ERROR tail-timeout seq=256 kv_miss=0.78 retry=0
2026-03-17T15:12:09.002Z gateway ERROR 504 id=rQ-9932
```

deploy-bot: recent canary deploy applied to hosted-us-west1 at 2026-03-17T15:00Z — commit: f4b2a8c. No automatic rollback.

olivia: looking at metrics, there's a clear continuous-batcher backlog spike starting 15:05Z. KV cache spin-up on new pods caused transient cold misses; batcher queue depth climbed and hit the soft cap, then we started early-rejecting which bubbled to 504s and long tails.

jordan: can you reproduce with small script? maybe the batcher backpressure threshold is too high for this pattern (many small chats + sporadic long context).

maya: repro script: curl --header 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-4b","input":"short chat"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate - use ~200 concurrent streams with jitter. Customer load peaks ~1200 rps bursted.

samir: quick mitigation I can push: lower continuous_batcher.max_depth from 512 -> 256 for us-west1 and scale up dedicated pool by +2 pods. Also lower max_batch_hold_ms from 12 -> 6 to reduce tail assembly latency. Would apply now as a hotfix.

olivia: also recommend enabling kvcache prewarm for new pods for this tenant (Flyby is high-activity). That should cut miss storm.

support-bot: ticket #C-4527 updated: customer notified we're investigating and applying mitigations. ETA update +15m.

maya: samir — please proceed with hotfix. I'll keep Flyby PM updated.

samir: applying change to us-west1 (hotpatch) now. patch: {"continuous_batcher.max_depth":256,"continuous_batcher.max_batch_hold_ms":6}

deploy-bot: config change rolled to staged hosts in us-west1 at 2026-03-17T15:18Z. No restart required for batcher config.

maya: observing metrics — queue depth dropping, tail p95 shrinking. Will monitor for 30m and then follow up.

jordan: after hotfix, rerun replay, verified 504s dropped from ~12/min -> 0-1/min and p95 down to ~1.2s.

maya: thanks. I'm going to keep this thread pinned on the incident doc. :thumbsup:
